done_when: A test with a branch ahead 2 whose changed files equal origin/fast-track tip lets stop_guard.reason return None; same test fails on the old guard; test_stop_guard.py and the B17 tests still pass
goal: stop_guard blocks a stop when the branch is ahead of origin/fast-track but its content is already on trunk (sync.ahead_commits compares HEAD to the merge-base only, so after trunk took the same change a merge-base diff is non-empty). Count as shipped when git diff origin/fast-track HEAD limited to the files changed since the merge-base is empty.

latest.line: Result: sync.py health prints NOTE OLD-SHELL for any bash/sh over 30 min (extends bg_watch

note: Twin check: B17 (commit 'identical tree = nothing ahead') covers HEAD == merge-base only; this is the moved-trunk case. sync.py is the gate script: smoke gate applies.
scope_out: any rule that lets unshipped content stop
sources: Builder Noticed 2026-11-11: main checkout jis-nb-trunk ahead 8, ship says nothing to ship
steps: Read sync.ahead_commits (line 1523) and the B17 tests in test_stop_guard.py (lines 60-80)
Extend ahead_commits: files = diff --name-only merge-base..HEAD; if non-empty and git diff --quiet origin/fast-track HEAD -- files, return 0; fail closed on git errors (keep n)
Add the fail-first test; run test_stop_guard.py and test_sync.py
tests: scripts/dev/test_stop_guard.py: new test, branch ahead with content already on a moved trunk gives reason None (fails on old code, ahead stays 2)
title: Stop guard false alarm: commits ahead of trunk with an empty tree diff (content already on trunk, e.g. main checkout jis-nb-trunk ahead 8, sync.py ship says nothing to ship) must count as shipped; done when a test with such a branch lets the stop pass and fails on the old guard
